name: How does Hometelligent ensure quality in one-bedroom ADU construction?

mainEntity.name: How does Hometelligent ensure quality in one-bedroom ADU construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent ensures quality in one-bedroom ADU construction through a comprehensive project management approach, including regular site supervision, adherence to established building codes, and selection of durable materials. Our process includes a detailed pre-construction checklist and a phased inspection schedule to verify compliance and craftsmanship at every stage. We focus on transparent communication with clients throughout the build to address any concerns proactively and maintain high standards.
